headline: Parque Arauco Reports 18.6% Q3 Revenue Growth Across Operations
summary: Parque Arauco S.A. reported its third-quarter 2026 financial results, highlighting an 18.6% increase in revenue and a 17.3% year-over-year rise in EBITDA to reach $87 million, supported by its markets in Chile, Peru, and Colombia.
why: Earnings reports provide key visibility into a real estate operator's cash flows, occupancy rates, and regional consumer demand across Latin America.
